nsre01.title: A hand-knitted hat
nsre01.caption:
A lumpy hand-knitted hat, reviewed without a single word.
Dropped stitches, zero complaints. Made by them wins.

nwfe01.title: Your side first
nwfe01.caption:
Ever watched someone scrape a windshield very, very slowly?
It was clearing your side first.

nwfe02.title: Built you in snow
nwfe02.caption:
When your Aries builds the worst snowman you've ever seen.
Turns out it was a portrait. Of you.

nwfe04.title: Pre-warmed
nwfe04.caption:
Your coat is being held hostage by the radiator.
Some people say I love you with a warm coat.

nwfe05.title: You said it once
nwfe05.caption:
Why does your Capricorn keep writing in that notebook?
Every little thing you mentioned once. Remembered.

nwfe06.title: Baked your sign
nwfe06.caption:
Waiting all evening while someone kneads the same dough?
Worth it when the bread comes out shaped like your sign.

nwfe07.title: Both, side by side
nwfe07.caption:
Libra cannot pick an ornament. Classic.
Sometimes the answer is both, on the same branch.
